guides.main.welcome:
Welcome to ChatterUI!

Let me give you a quick tour.
guides.main.characters:
Your characters live here. Choose one to start a conversation.

AI Bot has already been prepared for you.
guides.main.import: Use this button to add or import characters.
guides.main.menu: Open the main menu here to change app mode and manage your setup.
guides.chat.history: Use these buttons to view chat history or start a new chat with this character. You can also swipe left to open the chat drawer.
guides.chat.options: Your chat options are here, including context usage, author notes, and summaries.
guides.drawer.persona: Tap your persona here to change your name, description, or image.
guides.drawer.options: These are the app’s tools and settings. Feel free to explore once this guide is finished!
